notes.subject: kɔgɔjiɲɛna
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'my soul thirsts'; Bambara says my life-breath thirsted for water — kɔgɔji (big water) used for intense thirst.

notes.subject: ואראה פני
notes.rationale: 'And I appear/see the face of' — cultic appearing before God in the sanctuary vs literal seeing; both senses live in a ye ɲɛda.

notes.subject: waati di min na
notes.rationale: The question 'when shall I come?' is left unanswered — a genuine open question to God.

notes.subject: to Elohim
notes.rationale: The verse is an implicit address to God, the object of thirst.

translation: Nin in kɔgɔjiɲɛna Elohim la, Ala ka balo la, waati di min na n na wa a ye Ala ɲɛda ye?
